taste:
The Skinny Chicken Burger combines tender, savoury grilled chicken with crisp vegetables and a soft bun. Lettuce gives the filling some crunch, while fresh tomato keeps the combination light and fresh. The contrast is straightforward: warm chicken at the centre, softer bread around it and crisp lettuce between bites. This is a chicken burger with a salad accompaniment, rather than a bunless version.

The side salad is the main distinction on the plate. Crisp greens and a light vinaigrette offer a zesty contrast to the chicken, with salad taking the place of chips. That makes it a useful choice when you want the familiar burger format but prefer a fresh side.
